05 / GOOD TO KNOW

A few things to know.

Every partnership should start with clear expectations. Here are answers to the most common questions.

Do I need to keep inventory?

No. The partner opportunity is designed without a requirement to stock products. Specific order and fulfilment arrangements are discussed during onboarding.

Do I need sales experience?

Previous beauty sales experience is not required to express interest. You should be willing to learn the product and communicate accurately with customers.

Do I need to try the product first?

Yes. The program is product-first, so you can understand the routine before recommending it. Any product purchase or trial costs are explained before joining.

How does commission work?

Commission is based on eligible, confirmed sales under the applicable partner agreement. The exact rate, payment timing, refunds and order rules are shared individually before you decide to participate. Income is not guaranteed.

How do I apply in Cambodia?

Visit our Instagram profile @lashaunnie.kh and send the message “AGENT”. We will explain the next steps and current eligibility conditions.
